dimensions.assessment: Accelerates federal permitting and transparency for qualifying critical mineral projects unless opt-out is requested.

importance_detail.rationale: This bill designates certain Defense Production Act actions by the Secretary of Defense regarding critical minerals as covered projects for streamlined federal permitting and inclusion on the Permitting Dashboard.
